## Introduction

Revision 8 proposes a sender and receiver model for asynchronous execution.

## Design

### Senders

A sender describes work. `std::execution::then` attaches a continuation in revision 8.

```cpp
auto snd = std::execution::just(42) | std::execution::then([](int i) { return i + 8; });
```

### Schedulers

A scheduler is a lightweight handle to an execution resource.
